contexts.text: (This occurs in the Word) that men may lay open the feelings of the mind... which is wont to be a healing.
That healings, cures, remedies, and medicines, are not mentioned in the Word in a natural but in a spiritual sense. Illustrated.
I will bring it healing, and cure ().
(Evil uses) are serviceable in absorbing malignities, and thus as remedies.
This is the sole cure of their insanity, that they are sent into works under a judge in Hell...
